metadata.title: Nakai-Moishezon type criteria for Hessian type equations on compact Kähler manifolds
metadata.abstract: We establish numerical criteria for polynomial positivity of real $(1,1)$-classes on compact Kähler manifolds for strictly right-Noetherian polynomials. As applications, we obtain existence and uniqueness for the generalized Monge-Ampère equations with a smooth zeroth coefficient, the complex Hessian and Hessian quotient equations, and the critical LYZ equation. We also characterize the cone of $k$-positive classes as a connected component of a numerical positivity cone.
